relations: Vigorous boiling of the dark liquid produces continuous bubbling and rising steam while the kettle remains stationary on the foil.
A fingertip briefly appears near the spout without shifting the kettle or interrupting the rolling boil.
Churning of the liquid gradually reveals a yellowish-green solid mass at the left edge of the surface.
caption: The video captures a top-down close view of an open golden kettle with a black-gripped overhead handle resting on crinkled aluminium foil on a stovetop. To the left, a metal gas-hob grate with a black knob is visible, while white tiled walls, a small brown object, and a blue bowl of rice occupy the background. Inside the kettle, a dark reddish-brown liquid churns in a vigorous rolling boil, with bubbles forming, bursting, and steam drifting upward. The surface turbulence shifts continuously, yet the kettle, foil, and surrounding objects show no visible displacement. A fingertip appears briefly near the lower edge by the spout, withdraws, and later appears again, without moving the kettle. As the boiling continues, a yellowish-green solid mass becomes visible at the left side of the liquid, with the churning contents shifting. The view stays centered on this ongoing process, showing persistent bubbling, steam, and shifting liquid motion.
